records.localization_note: Keep Hodram Bergstrom for the speaking header and the native surname Escante uses. Admiral is his spoken office.
Keep Maria Li for the negotiator in Sao Jorge. Her affiliation is supplied separately through FO.
Keep Julio Erneco. He names his relationship to Cristina in speech.
Keep Camille Overijssel in the nameplate and Camille where Hodram recognizes the visitor.
Keep Xien Yan for Maria's companion who defends the townspeople.
Keep Yukihisa Shiraki in the nameplate and the separate Genjo catalogue field. His interpretation does not make him a ninja.
Keep Angelo Puccini. His teasing and Italian exclamation identify his voice without a role label.
Keep Gerhard Adernkatz. His private advice is distinct from the admiral's decision.
Keep Charles Rochefort in the nameplate and Jean in the separate catalogue field. His interest in science is expressed in his own words.
Keep Samwell Khan in the nameplate and the separate da catalogue component. His familiar Peacock Mail speech matches the other route.
Keep Manuel Almeida for the crew member who handles resupply advice.
Keep Diogo Escante in the nameplate, with de in the separate catalogue field and the full name in the guildmaster's introduction.
Keep Jorge Albacete for the man who warns Hodram to watch his mouth. The introduction gives him no new office.
Port Worker fits the dock attendant who recognizes amber and relays the rumor.
Priest fits the officiant who gives the sword and offers a blessing.
Guildmaster is the role introducing Escante in the guild.
Bandit fits the source role in the argument with Maria. The exchange gives no personal name.
Keep Benazir as the name of the speaker who returns a favor with a lead about India.
